name: Safe Load Indicator – Pick & Carry Crane
tagline: Advanced hydraulic protection and display-based calibration for safe lifting operations
overview: The Hejaaz Technologies Pick & Carry Crane SLI (Model SLI-PNC/V1.1) is an advanced safety system designed specifically for Pick & Carry crane operations. It prevents overloading, boom collisions, and unsafe lifting conditions through real-time monitoring and automatic hydraulic cut-off protection. The system features an integrated 20×4 LCD display for on-site calibration and configuration, ensuring reliable operation in remote and harsh environments.

safetyParameters.title: Safe Working Load (SWL) Cut-Off
safetyParameters.description: Automatic hydraulic cut-off when capacity is exceeded. Prevents toppling and structural failure.

safetyParameters.title: Anti-Two-Block (A2B) Protection
safetyParameters.description: Detects hook proximity to boom head. Stops hoist-up motion automatically.

safetyParameters.title: Hydraulic Cut-Off System
safetyParameters.description: Prevents unsafe crane movement during fault or overload conditions.

safetyParameters.title: Display-Based Calibration
safetyParameters.description: On-board 20×4 LCD for setup and real-time monitoring without external tools.

systemComponents: Pressure sensors (2-core wire) for load measurement
Load cell (4-core wire) for precise weight sensing
Contactless limit switches for position detection
Cable tension drum with angle and length sensors
Alarm unit with buzzer and LED indicators
workingPrinciple: The system uses hydraulic pressure-based sensing and load sensors to continuously monitor the actual load on the crane. Combined with boom angle and length measurements, the microprocessor calculates the real-time load percentage against the crane's Safe Working Load (SWL). Visual and audible alarms activate at pre-set warning levels (typically 85% SWL), and automatic hydraulic cut-off engages when limits are exceeded. The Anti-Two-Block system uses contactless limit switches on the cable drum to detect hook proximity to boom head, preventing dangerous collisions.

Industrial-grade IP65 enclosure for harsh site conditions

Automatic data validation and fault diagnostics

Two-stage alarm (warning / overload)

name: Safe Load Indicator – Crawler Crane
tagline: Advanced Load Moment Limiter with Wind Monitoring for Heavy-Duty Operations
overview: The Hejaaz Technologies Crawler Crane SLI (Model SLI-XGC400-I) is a comprehensive Load Moment Indicator (LMI) system designed for lattice and telescopic boom crawler cranes. It provides real-time load moment calculation, wind speed monitoring, and automatic hydraulic cut-off protection to prevent structural overload and ensure safe heavy-lifting operations in demanding site conditions.

safetyParameters.title: Safe Working Load (SWL) Cut-Off
safetyParameters.description: Monitors lifted load against rated SWL. Automatic hydraulic cut-off during overload considering boom length, angle, radius, and configuration.

safetyParameters.title: Load Moment Limiter (LML)
safetyParameters.description: Calculates load moment using load and operating radius. Prevents crane tipping and boom overstress with hydraulic cut-off.

safetyParameters.title: Wind Speed Monitoring
safetyParameters.description: Real-time wind monitoring with automatic lifting restrictions during high wind to prevent load swing and instability.

safetyParameters.title: Hydraulic Cut-Off & Operating Control
safetyParameters.description: Automatic cut-off when SWL exceeded, load moment limit reached, or unsafe track/slew/wind conditions detected.

systemComponents: Angle tilting sensor for boom positioning
Load sensor for precise weight measurement
Standard limit switch for safety monitoring
Alarm unit with buzzer and LED indicators
workingPrinciple: The system continuously monitors lifted load, boom angle, boom length, and operating radius. The microprocessor calculates the real-time load moment and compares it against the crane's rated capacity considering the current configuration. Wind speed is monitored through an anemometer, and the system automatically restricts operations when permissible limits are exceeded. Visual and audible alarms activate as limits are approached, and automatic hydraulic cut-off engages to prevent hoisting, slewing, and travel during unsafe conditions.

name: Safe Load Indicator – Telescopic Crane
tagline: Multi-Section Boom Extension Safety with Load Moment Limiting
overview: The Hejaaz Technologies Telescopic Crane SLI (Model SLI-TSC/V1.1) is a precision safety system designed for mobile and truck-mounted telescopic cranes. It monitors boom extension, angle, and load in real-time to provide comprehensive Load Moment Limiting (LML) and Anti-Two-Block (A2B) protection, ensuring fail-safe operations during complex lifting maneuvers.

safetyParameters.title: Safe Working Load (SWL) Cut-Off
safetyParameters.description: Prevents lifting beyond rated capacity. Automatically cuts off hoisting to prevent structural damage.

safetyParameters.title: Anti-Two-Block (A2B) Protection
safetyParameters.description: Detects safe distance between hook and boom tip. Prevents wire rope and boom head damage.

safetyParameters.title: Load Moment Limiter (LML)
safetyParameters.description: Calculates load vs radius in real-time. Prevents crane overturning and boom overstress.

safetyParameters.title: Hydraulic Cut-Off Protection
safetyParameters.description: Stops unsafe movement during faults or overload. Ensures fail-safe crane operation.

systemComponents: Hydraulic pressure sensors for load measurement
Boom angle and multi-stage length sensors
Tower lamp for visual status warning
Contactless limit switch for A2B protection
workingPrinciple: The system measures hook load, boom angle, and extended length across all telescopic stages. The microprocessor calculates the current operating radius and compares the actual load against the crane's load chart. Real-time LML calculation prevents tipping, while A2B sensors prevent hook-to-boom collisions. Alarms and hydraulic lockouts activate automatically when safe limits are breached.

Real-time load, radius, and boom length display

Automatic hydraulic lockout for overload and A2B

Sunlight-readable 20×4 LCD operator interface
Secure password-protected calibration menus

name: Safe Load Indicator – Tower Crane
tagline: Precision load monitoring for tower cranes
overview: Our Safe Load Indicator (SLI) for Tower Cranes provides real-time load monitoring, radius-based capacity calculation, and overload prevention. Designed for construction and high-rise projects where tower cranes operate at varying radii and heights.

safetyParameters.title: Moment Limit
safetyParameters.description: Prevents structural failure by tracking load x radius.

safetyParameters.title: Radius Safety
safetyParameters.description: Automatic cut-off when reaching safe working limits.

safetyParameters.title: Wind Monitor
safetyParameters.description: Continuous velocity tracking for site stability.

safetyParameters.title: Fault Alert
safetyParameters.description: Immediate diagnostics for all connected sensors.

workingPrinciple: The system measures hook load via load cell or boom strain, boom angle via inclinometer, and boom length where applicable. A microprocessor computes the moment (load × radius) and compares it against the crane’s load chart. Visual and audible alarms trigger when approaching or exceeding safe limits.
keyFeatures: Real-time load, radius, and moment display
Configurable overload and warning setpoints
Data logging and optional connectivity
Rugged enclosure (IP54+) for site conditions
Compliance with IS 14475 and similar standards

name: Safe Load Indicator – Tipper Truck
tagline: Payload monitoring and tipping stability for heavy trucks
overview: The Hejaaz Technologies Tipper Truck SLI (Model TT-SLI / V1.0) is a dedicated safety system designed for dump trucks and tippers. It provides continuous payload monitoring, body position alerts (DALA Raise), and anti-tilt protection to prevent vehicle overturning during discharge and transport operations in mining and construction sites.

safetyParameters.title: DALA Raise Alarm
safetyParameters.description: Detects raised tipper body. Triggers buzzer and display status to prevent travel with body raised.

safetyParameters.title: Overload Protection
safetyParameters.description: Continuous load monitoring. Changes tower lamp from Green to Red and displays warning during overload.

safetyParameters.title: Anti-Tilt Indicator
safetyParameters.description: Monitors chassis tilt angle. Triggers buzzer and warning if tilt exceeds ±7° to prevent overturning.

systemComponents: Load cell for precise payload measurement
MEMS tilt sensor for chassis stability
20×4 LCD display unit for cab mounting
workingPrinciple: The system monitors payload weight via load cells and truck tilt via a MEMS-based inclinometer. It also tracks the tipper body (DALA) status. A microprocessor compares real-time data against safety limits (±7° tilt and rated load). Overload conditions trigger a red tower lamp and cab display warning, while a raised body or excessive tilt activates the audible buzzer to ensure safe discharge and travel.
keyFeatures: Gross, tare, and net payload weight display
DALA body-up detection and alarm logic
±7° tilt angle monitoring and safety lockout
Tower lamp status (Green: Safe | Red: Overload)
Cab-mounted 20×4 LCD interface
